registered: 2026-10-27, after dev (9b dev 10 items, one setting) and before any test run

arms.B4: photo-judged material annotation (abo-texture/test-b4-ir, scored in test-b4.json)
arms.B2: B4 IR plus material.albedoPatch on every part the model marked patterned, taken from the frame-0 photo (scripts/abo-photo-patch.ts: silhouette camera fit with the view prior, IoU >= 0.8, largest interior square 96/64/48/32/24 px, low-frequency shading divided out); everything else unchanged

affected: items where B2 attached at least one patch (decided by the script, before scoring)

S3 affected items: median paired (B2 - B4) deltaE00 <= +1.0 (non-inferiority)
S4 descriptive: same comparisons split by textured / untextured reference and over all 33 items
why: slices 13–14 showed that paired CIs over all items sit at 0 because unaffected items tie exactly; the sign test on affected items is the registered remedy
